title: What is WinProx?
lead: WinProx is the digital time clock for time tracking, connected with planning and work organisation. Staff clock in with their phone, without an app. You compare the hours with the roster and pass them to your social secretariat. Issues, tasks and inspection rounds belong to the same experience. Turn CIAO on in Settings.

what.title: Core idea
what.body: A worker scans a QR on the screen, on a sticker or via a link, and clocks in and out. You see the hours next to the roster. The social secretariat prepares the wage. Issues, tasks and inspection rounds run in the same app. Turn CIAO on in Settings when the crew works at customer sites; the NSSO link (enterprise number) is confirmed before filing starts. A crew on its own site leaves it off.

audience.title: Who it is for
items: Companies that want to record hours without an app
Crews that work at customer sites and need presence reporting to the social security office

items.name: Work organisation
items.text: Issues, tasks, inspection rounds, calendar and briefing belong to the regular WinProx plans. Not a separate product on top of Time.

items.name: Checkmate
items.text: Limited plan for clocking in and out on site: GPS customer visits, breaks and My hours — no rosters, issues or tasks. Cleaning is the current use; construction is not generally available yet. CIAO from the start; enterprise number in Settings. €5 per worker per month.

items.name: WinProx Time
items.text: The recognisable name for the punch clock, time tracking and roster. Clock in/out via Clock Point, presence, timesheets and planning — included in every regular plan. Turn CIAO on in Settings.

items.name: ESG
items.text: Measurements and indicators linked to units and follow-up tasks. Available on WinProx Corporate according to the contractual agreement.

items.name: IoT Connect
items.text: Sensor gateways: alarms become issues and tasks. Available on WinProx Corporate according to the contractual agreement.

items.name: API & webhooks
items.text: REST API and outbound webhooks for system integrations. Available on WinProx Corporate according to the contractual agreement.

tech.title: Technology
tech.body: Web application (Laravel + Livewire). Public QR portals work on phones without install. Multilingual (NL, EN, FR, DE, ES, IT) with optional AI translation of report text.

compliance.title: Privacy & compliance
items: GDPR-oriented design with public privacy and DPA documents
Photos and text on public QR pages stay blurred until approval
Tenant isolation: data per organisation, no product sector on the tenant
Optional CIAO transfer (NISS, presence) to the Belgian NSSO — only if you turn it on

languages.title: Languages
languages.body: Interface and marketing in Dutch, English, French, German, Spanish and Italian.
